svg.aria-label: System 1 supervising one run of thirteen turns. It looks at turn 4 and calls the turns advancing, so its next look is turn 8. At turn 8 re-investigating and retrying together pass 0.7, a stuck verdict, so it looks again at turn 9; still stuck, it nudges System 2 to make the change as its next call. Turns 10 and 11 edit and pass the tests, and the look at turn 13 calls them advancing. 0.6 s a look. Replayed over 42 stored runs (1,935 turns), the rule sent 23 stuck nudges and asked System 1 at 27% of turns. The probability bars are drawn for illustration.
svg.text: nudge → System 2: make the change as the next call
A look at turn 4, then every fourth turn; a stuck look is checked again at the next turn, and the nudge goes out if it holds.
0.6 s a look. Replayed over 42 stored runs (1,935 turns): 23 stuck nudges, System 1 asked at 27% of turns. Bars are illustrative.
